span.p:
SC-005 exception
Every section is at `review`. The expert asks whether a team could build the set. Two release-line stages have no `must` requirement.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Trigger
They ask for the buildability review.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p: They see a verdict of buildable with gaps

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: They see the two stages that have no requirement behind them, named

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: They see three requirements an engineer could not write a test for, each quoted

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: They see what the reviewer would ask for first, in order

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: They fix two of them and record the third as an open question with a decider and a date

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Expected
The expert knows exactly what a builder cannot build before anyone has estimated, and every gap is either closed or owned by a named decider with a date.
